items.title: What Does Eli Lilly (LLY) Gain From Its $2.88 Billion Immunology Deal?
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) agreed to acquire Merida Biosciences in a deal valued at up to US$2.88b to expand its immunology pipeline. The transaction brings Merida's platform for selectively degrading pathogenic autoantibodies while maintaining normal immune function into Lilly's portfolio. Merida's lead autoimmune and allergy candidate is in Phase 1 and is expected to support Lilly's move beyond its established focus on diabetes and obesity therapies.
